title: Chivu: Inter miał właściwe podejście, nie może dominować od początku do końca w Lidze Mistrzów
summary: MEDIOLAN, WŁOCHY - 25 LISTOPADA: Cristian Chivu, menadżer FC Internazionale Milano, rozmawia z Petarem Suciciem z FC Internazionale Milano podczas meczu fazy MD5 Ligi Mistrzów UEFA 2026/27 pomiędzy FC Internazi
content:
MEDIOLAN, WŁOCHY - 25 LISTOPADA: Cristian Chivu, menadżer FC Internazionale Milano, rozmawia z Petarem Suciciem z FC Internazionale Milano podczas meczu fazy MD5 Ligi Mistrzów UEFA 2026/27 pomiędzy FC Internazionale Milano i VfB Stuttgart na Stadio San Siro 25 listopada 2026 roku w Mediolanie, Włochy.

(Zdjęcie: Marco Luzzani/Getty Images) Cristian Chivu upiera się, że Inter zachował właściwą postawę podczas zwycięstwa 2:0 nad VfB Stuttgart i ostrzega, że „w Lidze Mistrzów nie można dominować od początku do końca”.

Nerazzurri czuli presję po tym, jak w weekend stracili prowadzenie 4:2 i zremisowali 4:4 z Atalantą w Serie A, wiedzieli, że to mecz, który trzeba wygrać, aby wyprzedzić VfB Stuttgart w tabeli Ligi Mistrzów.

To był ciężki mecz, o którym zdecydował dopiero rzut karny Petara Sucića za zagranie ręką, a Lautaro Martinez wchodzący z ławki rezerwowych ustalił wynik na 2:0.

„Polegaliśmy na mentalności, organizacji, intensywności, zaakceptowaniu tego, że mecze Ligi Mistrzów nie są łatwe i że nie można ich zdominować od początku do końca” – Chivu powiedział Sky Sport Italia.

content:
PARYŻ, FRANCJA – 25 LISTOPADA: Gian Piero Gasperini, menadżer AS Roma, patrzy przed meczem Ligi Mistrzów UEFA 2026/27 League Phase MD5 pomiędzy Paris Saint-Germain i AS Roma w Parc des Princes 25 listopada 2026 roku w Paryżu, Francja.

„Gdybyśmy pozostali w grze, druga połowa byłaby decydująca”.

title: Poch denied first Man Utd win by Lammens howler at Sporting
summary:
Sporting Lisbon
                          vs Manchester United. UEFA Champions League Round 1.
content:
Sporting Lisbon vs Manchester United.

UEFA Champions League Round 1.

Report as Man Utd self-destruct in bizarre Champions League draw at Sporting; Bruno Fernandes scored twice, including freak goal that bounced off a divot in the ground; Sporting striker Luis Suarez also scored two, benefitting from Senne Lammens' second-half howler Mauricio Pochettino was denied a first victory as Manchester United head coach by a goalkeeping howler from Senne Lammens in an incident-packed 2-2 draw with Sporting in the Champions League as Youri Tielemans was sent off late on.

United looked to be on course for a first away win of the season after captain Bruno Fernandes scored two goals in the first five minutes of the second half only for Lammens to spill the ball in the box for Luis Suarez to equalise with his second goal of the game.

Fernandes thought he had produced a third goal for United to go back in front for a second time shortly after Lammens' error when Sporting goalkeeper Kaique punched into his own net only for it to be ruled out for a foul by Patrick Dorgu following VAR intervention.

summary: Report as Liverpool overpowered Club Brugge in Belgium with two goals from Alexander Isak and a fine strike from Florian Wirtz; Andoni Iraola's side rise to fifth in the Champions League phase standings, in pri
content:
Report as Liverpool overpowered Club Brugge in Belgium with two goals from Alexander Isak and a fine strike from Florian Wirtz; Andoni Iraola's side rise to fifth in the Champions League phase standings, in prime position to finish inside the automatic qualifying spots Liverpool recovered from their shock defeat to Fenerbahce in their last Champions League outing to beat Club Brugge 3-0 and improve their chances of a top-eight league phase finish.

Andoni Iraola's side have had no problem scoring goals in Europe, but faced issues keeping them out.

Brugge were most obliging hosts in that respect, a far cry from the regularly free-scoring side that have so far averaged 2.75 goals per game and beaten Inter Milan at the San Siro.

Felix Lemarechal was the home side's greatest threat.

But Alexander Isak was far more decisive, netting the opener following Yann Sommer's misplaced pass before rounding off the scoring in the second half with a deft chip to beat the goalkeeper.

content:
Ermedin Demirovic believes that Stuttgart will start scoring again, after the barren run in front of goal continued against Inter Milan on Wednesday.

Die Schwaben had their chances in transition on the night, with Demirovic himself starting well up top.

However, second-half goals from Petar Sucic and Lautaro Martinez would seal a 2-0 win for the Nerazzurri, who picked up their third Champions League win in a row.

Speaking to DAZN immediately after the final whistle, the Bosnian forward gave his thoughts on another frustrating evening.

“I think we had our chances to take the lead, especially with the crowd behind us,” said Demirovic, after VfB started well.

title: Stuttgart wasteful again as Sucic and Lautaro seal Inter win
summary: As Stuttgart looked to get back to winning ways in Europe following the defeat to Galatasaray, they could hardly have gotten off to a more encouraging start, with the visitors testing Italian giants Inter in th
content:
As Stuttgart looked to get back to winning ways in Europe following the defeat to Galatasaray, they could hardly have gotten off to a more encouraging start, with the visitors testing Italian giants Inter in the early stages.

Maximilian Mittelstädt fired in a teasing ball after six minutes, flying a matter of centimetres past the foot of Ermedin Demirovic.

The Bosnian forward, and skipper on the night, would be presented with an opportunity again just over a minute later, linking up well with Chris Führich before seeing a shot blocked.

Führich, who was Stuttgart's best player in Istanbul before the international break, remained at the heart of proceedings, seeing an effort well saved by Josep Martinez on the half-volley, before Djed Spence was denied by Dennis Seimen at the other end following the resulting corner.

And after the strong Stuttgart start, it would be all Inter for the rest of the half, with Marcus Thuram and Nicolo Barella having the best chances - the former hitting the side netting after a poor Finn Jeltsch backpass, while Barella struck the post with a lovely outside-of-the-boot effort inside the box.

summary: On a night in which Bayern Munich were looking to reset the mood after a week of injuries and controversy behind the scenes, Vincent Kompany would be left to field a far-from-ideal lineup with multiple stars wa
content:
On a night in which Bayern Munich were looking to reset the mood after a week of injuries and controversy behind the scenes, Vincent Kompany would be left to field a far-from-ideal lineup with multiple stars watching on from the sidelines.

Konrad Laimer's versatility has been well-documented throughout his years in the Bundesliga, but few could have predicted that the Austrian would be the man to start up top in Lille.

And much to their credit, the German record champions did not have to get out of second gear in the first half, despite the rather makeshift lineup.

Dayot Upamecano would open the scoring in Northern France after just 15 minutes, rising highest to meet Tom Bischof's corner to head home from six yards out.

From then on, Bayern were cruising, before the half-time break completely turned the tide.

content:

Imponujący 45-minutowy epizod Bellinghama miał miejsce zaledwie dziewięć dni po znakomitym, pełnym akcji występie dla Anglii w wygranym 3:2 Lidze Narodów w Hiszpanii.

summary: WŁOCHY - 16 września: Davide Bartesaghi z AC Milan rywalizuje o piłkę z Danielem Banjaqui z SL Benfica podczas meczu fazy ligowej MD1 Ligi Europejskiej UEFA 2026/27 pomiędzy AC Milan i SL Benfica na Stadio San
content:
WŁOCHY - 16 września: Davide Bartesaghi z AC Milan rywalizuje o piłkę z Danielem Banjaqui z SL Benfica podczas meczu fazy ligowej MD1 Ligi Europejskiej UEFA 2026/27 pomiędzy AC Milan i SL Benfica na Stadio San Siro 16 września 2026 roku we Włoszech.

(Zdjęcie: Marco Luzzani/Getty Images) Davide Bartesaghi to kolejny zawodnik Milanu, który zgłosił obawy przed kontuzją przed czwartkowym wyjazdowym meczem swojej drużyny z Olympiakosem w Lidze Europy i zgodnie z najnowszymi aktualizacjami nie pojedzie z drużyną Rossoneri do Aten.

Doniesienia ze środowego poranka potwierdziły, że Francesco Camarda miał duże wątpliwości co do występu w meczu z Olympiakosem po tym, jak na początku tygodnia doznał kontuzji kostki.

Według doniesień Gianluki Di Marzio, podczas środowej porannej sesji treningowej Bartesaghi również podniósł się z powodu zapalenia ścięgna prawej nogi i nie będzie mógł grać w czwartek.

Bartesaghi wystąpił w barwach Milanu w swoim pierwszym meczu po niedawnej przerwie na mecze reprezentacyjne w weekend, który zakończył się zwycięstwem u siebie 5:1 z Frosinone w Serie A.

title: Camarda the latest on Milan’s list of eight absences for Olympiacos clash
summary: PERTH, AUSTRALIA - AUGUST 05: Aleksandar Stankovic of FC Internazionale turns with the ball during the pre-season match between AC Milan and FC Internazionale at Optus Stadium on August 05, 2026 in Perth, Austr
content:
PERTH, AUSTRALIA - AUGUST 05: Aleksandar Stankovic of FC Internazionale turns with the ball during the pre-season match between AC Milan and FC Internazionale at Optus Stadium on August 05, 2026 in Perth, Australia.

(Photo by James Worsfold/Getty Images) Francesco Camarda is the latest Milan player to be ruled out of Milan’s upcoming Europa League clash against Olympiacos after picking up an ankle problem in training according to Wednesday’s reports.

Milan are due to take on Olympiacos in Athens on Thursday evening and will have to do so without eight of their first-team players.

Luka Modric is expected to be unavailable with a muscular issue, as are Strahinja Pavlovic, Matteo Gabbia, Samuel Chukwueze, Alexis Saelemaekers and Ruben Loftus-Cheek.

Camarda is the latest player to be added to the Milan injury list after suffering an ankle issue and is unlikely to be called up for the Olympiacos clash as a result.
